summary: Iteration 16 (biometric login + streak celebration + non-blocking email verification) fully validated. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_16_verify.py — signup returns email_verified=false, /auth/me carries the flag, email_events + email_verifications collections written with template 'email_verification', wrong verify code returns 400 with localized 'verify_invalid' (EN + DE), resend returns {ok:true}, 4th resend in 15min => 429, verified/demo user resend also returns {ok:true}, demo login + google/apple negative paths unchanged, existing users default email_verified=true. Frontend (mobile 390x844 web preview): fresh signup -> /agreement (accepted req-terms + req-disclaimer + agree-continue-button) -> Learn shows amber verify-email-banner; tapping it opens verify-modal with verify-code-input / verify-submit / verify-resend / Close; wrong code shows localized error text 'This code is invalid or has expired.'; verify-resend shows confirmation 'A new code is on its way.'. biometric-login-button correctly ABSENT on web (LocalAuthentication hardware unavailable). Happy-path email verification cannot be exercised via API (only hash stored) — validated structurally as instructed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py verify-email early-return for already-verified users (line 555-557) is idempotent — good UX. Consider recording a 200/no-op audit event, but not required.

_issue_email_code stores only sha256 hash of the 6-digit code (low entropy = 20-bit) — attempts limit (6) in verify_email correctly mitigates online brute force by wiping the record + returning 429. TTL 30 min via email_verifications.expires_at index also enforced. Design is sound.

resend-verification rate limit key 'verify:{user_id}' shares the in-memory _rl_buckets with other flows; not multi-worker safe (in-memory only). Acceptable while backend is single-worker uvicorn; document for future scale-out.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates one TEST_verify_<uuid>@example.com user (email_verified=false, on 7-day trial). Not cleaned up — harmless test data; retention driven by TTL indexes on email_verifications (30 min) and email_events (90 days).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 16 endpoints stable. Signup response and /auth/me carry email_verified (bool). Wrong verify code => 400 verify_invalid (localized). Resend rate limit 3 per 15 min in-memory. Happy-path verify only testable end-to-end via a real inbox (only sha256 hash of the emailed code is stored). Frontend testIDs confirmed working: verify-email-banner, verify-modal, verify-code-input, verify-submit, verify-resend, streak-celebration (only fires when streak>=1 on first login-of-day, so brand-new users won't see it — matches spec). biometric-login-button intentionally hidden on web (device-only).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only fix was a test-side email casing assertion (backend lowercases email on signup, which is correct).
